episodeTitle.en: Radical Candor: From theory to practice with author Kim Scott
episodeTitle.zh: 《激进坦诚》：从理论到实践 作者Kim Scott

guestBioOfficial.en: Kim Scott is the author of Radical Candor, currently the #1 most recommended book on this podcast. The book has sold over 1 million copies and has been translated into 23 languages. Before writing, Kim was a CEO coach at Dropbox, Qualtrics, Twitter, and other tech companies. She was also a member of the faculty at Apple University and before that led AdSense, YouTube, and DoubleClick teams at Google. This spring she’ll be launching Radical Respect, which she considers to be a prequel to Radical Candor. In today’s conversation, we go deep on Kim’s popular framework, including: • What separates radical candor and obnoxious aggression
guestBioOfficial.zh: Kim Scott是《激进坦诚》的作者，该书目前是本播客中推荐度最高的书籍。本书已售出超过100万册，并被翻译成23种语言。在写作之前，Kim曾在Dropbox、Qualtrics、推特等科技公司担任CEO教练。她还曾是苹果大学的教员，在此之前，她曾在谷歌领导AdSense、YouTube和DoubleClick团队。今年春天，她将推出《激进尊重》，她认为这是《激进坦诚》的前传。在今天的对话中，我们深入探讨了Kim广受欢迎的框架，包括：• 激进坦诚与令人不快的攻击行为的区别

title.en: Radical Candor: From theory to practice with author Kim Scott
title.zh: 《激进坦诚》：从理论到实践 作者Kim Scott

summary.en: Kim teaches that the best way to get feedback is to ask "What could I do or stop doing to make it easier to work with me?" rather than a generic request. She explains the two dimensions of Radical Candor - care personally and challenge directly. The episode is a practical guide to building a culture of honest, kind, and effective feedback.
summary.zh: 金指出，获取反馈最好的方式是问"我可以做些什么、或停止做什么，能让我们合作更顺畅？"，而不是泛泛地请求反馈。她阐释了《彻底坦率》的两个维度——真诚关怀与直接挑战。本期是一份关于建立诚实、善意且高效反馈文化的实用指南。
